name: Cohere
description: Let your AI use Cohere with your own API key: chat with Command models (with citations from your documents), create embeddings, rerank search results, transcribe audio, parse document images, count tokens, and check models, datasets, batches and embed jobs.
prerequisites: A Cohere account and an API key from dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys. Trial keys are free but rate limited and not for production; production keys bill every model call. About 2 minutes.

COHERE_API_KEY.label: Cohere API key
COHERE_API_KEY.help: dashboard.cohere.com, API Keys. A trial key is free and rate limited; a production key bills chat, embed, rerank, transcription and parse calls to the account.
COHERE_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the key as Cohere shows it, without spaces and without the word Bearer.

verifyHints.401: Cohere refused the API key: it is wrong or was deleted. Copy it again from https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys.
verifyHints.402: Cohere needs a payment method for this call. Add one under Billing at https://dashboard.cohere.com.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Cohere rate limited the key. Trial keys have low per-minute and monthly limits; wait, or switch to a production key.

instructions:
## Cohere
This connector calls the **Cohere API** (`https://api.cohere.com`, v2 for chat, embed, rerank, transcription and parse) with the user's own key: answers from Command models, grounded answers with citations from documents the user passes, embeddings for semantic search, reranking of search results, speech-to-text, document image parsing, tokenization, and the model list, datasets, batches and embed jobs of the account.

**Paid calls**: `cohere_chat`, `cohere_embed`, `cohere_rerank`, `cohere_transcribe_audio` and `cohere_parse_document` run a model. With a production key each call is billed (chat per input and output token, embed per token or image, rerank per search of up to 100 documents). A trial key is free but rate limited per minute and per month and may not be used commercially. Confirm with the user before large or repeated calls; set `max_tokens` to cap a chat reply. `cohere_tokenize`, `cohere_detokenize`, `cohere_check_api_key` and the list and get tools cost nothing.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. Sign up at https://dashboard.cohere.com.
2. Open **API Keys** (https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys) and copy the trial key, or create a production key after adding a payment method under Billing.
3. Paste it into `COHERE_API_KEY`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer` and only to Cohere.
4. Run `cohere_check_api_key` or `cohere_list_models` to check it.

**Models (check `cohere_list_models`, ids change)**
- Chat: `command-a-03-2025` (default choice), `command-a-reasoning-08-2025` (reasoning), `command-a-vision-07-2025` (images), `command-a-translate-08-2025` (translation), `command-r7b-12-2024` (small and cheap).
- Embed: `embed-v4.0` (text and images, `output_dimension` 256, 512, 1024 or 1536), `embed-v5.0-pro`, `embed-v5.0-fast`, `embed-multilingual-v3.0`.
- Rerank: `rerank-v5.0-pro`, `rerank-v5.0-fast`, `rerank-v3.5`.
- Transcribe: `cohere-transcribe-03-2026`. Parse: `parse-v5.0`.

**Workflow**
- Choose a model: `cohere_list_models` (filter `endpoint` chat, embed or rerank) and `cohere_get_model` for one model's context length, features and endpoints.
- Answer: `cohere_chat` with `model` and `messages`. Pass `documents` (strings or `{"data": {"title": "...", "snippet": "..."}}`) for a grounded answer; the reply then carries `message.citations` pointing into them. `response_format` forces JSON, `tools` adds function calling, `thinking` `{"type": "disabled"}` turns reasoning off on reasoning models.
- Search: `cohere_embed` turns up to 96 texts into vectors; use `input_type` `search_document` for what you store and `search_query` for the query. `cohere_rerank` orders up to 1,000 documents by relevance to a query and returns `results` with `index` (position in your list) and `relevance_score` (0 to 1).
- Audio and documents: `cohere_transcribe_audio` takes a public link to an audio file (flac, mp3, mpeg, mpga, ogg, wav, up to 10 MB through this connector) and the `language`; the connector downloads it and uploads it. `cohere_parse_document` turns an image of a page (public link or data URI, up to 20 MB; PDFs are not supported yet) into markdown or blocks.
- Tokens: `cohere_tokenize` counts the tokens of a text for a model, `cohere_detokenize` turns token ids back into text.
- Account data: `cohere_list_datasets`, `cohere_get_dataset` and `cohere_get_dataset_usage` (storage used, the limit is 10 GB per organization); `cohere_list_batches` and `cohere_get_batch` for Batch API jobs; `cohere_list_embed_jobs` and `cohere_get_embed_job` for embed jobs. Creating, cancelling and deleting them is not part of this connector.

**Reading answers**: chat returns `message.content[]` (items of `type` text with `text`), `finish_reason` (`COMPLETE`, `MAX_TOKENS`, `STOP_SEQUENCE`, `TOOL_CALL`, `ERROR`) and `usage.billed_units` with the billed input and output tokens. Embeddings are under `embeddings.float`, one vector per text in order. Dates are ISO 8601, UTC.

**Paging**: `cohere_list_models` and `cohere_list_batches` return `next_page_token`; pass it as `page_token` until it is empty. `cohere_list_datasets` pages with `limit` and `offset`.

**Not included**: the Classify, Summarize and Generate endpoints and connectors are deprecated by Cohere and left out; fine-tuning is deprecated as well.

**Errors**: 400 bad request (e.g. a parameter the model does not take, more than 96 texts); 401 invalid key; 402 payment method needed; 404 unknown model, dataset, batch or job; 422 the request could not be processed; 429 rate limit (trial keys are low, do not loop); 499 the request was cancelled; 500 and 503 Cohere-side errors, retry once later.

tools.name: cohere_list_models
tools.description: List the Cohere models available to this key, with endpoints they serve (chat, embed, rerank), context length, features and whether they are deprecated. Filter by endpoint; page with page_token = next_page_token. Free.

endpoint.description: Only models that serve this endpoint.

default_only.description: With endpoint: only the default model of that endpoint.

tools.name: cohere_get_model
tools.description: Read one Cohere model by name: endpoints, default endpoints, context length, features (e.g. tools, vision, reasoning), tokenizer URL and whether it is deprecated or fine-tuned. Free.

model.description: Model name, e.g. command-a-03-2025 or embed-v4.0.

tools.name: cohere_check_api_key
tools.description: Check that the Cohere API key is valid and active; returns valid plus the organization and owner ids. Free.

tools.name: cohere_chat
tools.description: Ask a Cohere Command model and get its reply (Chat API v2, non-streaming). Pass documents for a grounded answer with citations. COSTS MONEY with a production key: billed per input and output token (trial keys are free but rate limited). Confirm with the user before larger or repeated calls and set max_tokens to cap the cost.

model.description: Chat model, e.g. command-a-03-2025, command-a-reasoning-08-2025, command-a-vision-07-2025, command-r7b-12-2024 (cheapest).

messages.description: The conversation, oldest first: [{"role": "system", "content": "..."}, {"role": "user", "content": "..."}]. Roles: system, user, assistant, tool. Vision models take content as a list of parts such as {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "https://..."}}.

documents.description: Documents the model may cite: strings, or {"id": "doc1", "data": {"title": "...", "snippet": "..."}}. The reply then has message.citations.

max_tokens.description: Upper bound on output tokens. Set it to cap cost.

temperature.description: Randomness, default 0.3; lower is more deterministic.

stop_sequences.description: Up to 5 strings where generation stops.

tools.description: Function definitions: [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "...", "description": "...", "parameters": {...}}}]. The reply then has message.tool_calls; run them and send role tool messages back.

tool_choice.description: REQUIRED forces a tool call, NONE forbids one. Omit to let the model decide.

safety_mode.description: Safety instruction added to the prompt, default CONTEXTUAL.

thinking.description: Reasoning models: {"type": "disabled"} turns reasoning off, {"type": "enabled", "token_budget": 2000} caps it.

tools.name: cohere_embed
tools.description: Turn up to 96 texts (or images as data URIs) into embedding vectors for semantic search, clustering or classification (Embed API v2). Default embed-v4.0 with 256 float dimensions. COSTS MONEY with a production key: billed per token or image. Confirm with the user before embedding large collections.

images.description: Images as data URIs (data:image/png;base64,...) for image embeddings, with input_type image.

model.description: Embedding model, default embed-v4.0; also embed-v5.0-pro, embed-v5.0-fast, embed-multilingual-v3.0.

input_type.description: search_document for stored texts, search_query for the query, classification, clustering, or image.

output_dimension.description: Vector size for embed-v4.0 and newer, default 256 here to keep answers small.

truncate.description: How to cut inputs longer than the model allows: END (default), START, or NONE to get an error instead.

tools.name: cohere_rerank
tools.description: Order a list of documents by relevance to a query (Rerank API v2) and return the top results with their index in the list and a relevance_score from 0 to 1. COSTS MONEY with a production key: billed per search of up to 100 documents (longer documents count as several). Confirm with the user before large or repeated calls.

documents.description: Texts to rank, at most 1,000 (fewer is cheaper). Structured records can be passed as YAML strings.

model.description: Rerank model, default rerank-v5.0-fast; rerank-v5.0-pro is more accurate.

top_n.description: Return only the best n results. Omit for all.

max_tokens_per_doc.description: Truncate each document to this many tokens, default 4096.

tools.name: cohere_transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe speech in an audio file to text with Cohere Transcribe. Pass a public link: the connector downloads the file (up to 10 MB; flac, mp3, mpeg, mpga, ogg, wav) and uploads it. COSTS MONEY with a production key. Confirm with the user before transcribing their recordings.

audio_url.description: Public HTTPS link to the audio file.

language.description: Language of the audio as an ISO-639-1 code, e.g. en, de, ja. Required by Cohere.

model.description: Transcription model, default cohere-transcribe-03-2026 (cohere-transcribe-arabic-07-2026 for Arabic).

tools.name: cohere_parse_document
tools.description: Parse an image of a document page (scan, photo, screenshot) into markdown, with tables inlined, or into layout blocks (Parse API v2). Takes a public image link or a data URI up to 20 MB; PDFs are not supported yet. COSTS MONEY with a production key. Confirm with the user before parsing many pages.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS link to the image, or a data URI (data:image/png;base64,...).

output_format.description: markdown (default): markdown per page; blocks: typed layout blocks.

tools.name: cohere_tokenize
tools.description: Split a text into tokens with the tokenizer of a Cohere model and return the token ids and token strings, e.g. to count tokens before a chat call. Free.

model.description: Model whose tokenizer is used, default command-a-03-2025.

tools.name: cohere_detokenize
tools.description: Turn a list of token ids back into text with the tokenizer of a Cohere model. Free.

model.description: Model whose tokenizer is used, default command-a-03-2025.

tools.name: cohere_list_datasets
tools.description: List the datasets of the Cohere account (inputs for embed jobs, batches and fine-tuning) with id, name, type, validation status and creation time. Free.

dataset_type.description: Only this type, e.g. embed-input, embed-result, batch-chat-v2-input, batch-embed-v2-input, chat-finetune-input.

validation_status.description: Only datasets with this validation status.

before.description: Only datasets created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

after.description: Only datasets created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: cohere_get_dataset
tools.description: Read one Cohere dataset: name, type, validation status and error, schema, size and its parts. Free.

tools.name: cohere_get_dataset_usage
tools.description: Read how much dataset storage the Cohere organization uses, in bytes (the limit is 10 GB per organization). Free.

tools.name: cohere_list_batches
tools.description: List the Batch API jobs of the Cohere account with id, name, model, status, input and output dataset ids and request counts. Page with page_token = next_page_token. Free.

order_by.description: Sort order, e.g. created_at desc or updated_at desc.

tools.name: cohere_get_batch
tools.description: Read one Cohere batch job: status, model, input and output dataset ids, request counts (succeeded, failed) and timestamps. Free.

tools.name: cohere_list_embed_jobs
tools.description: List the embed jobs of the Cohere account with job id, name, status, model, input and output dataset ids and creation time. Free.

tools.name: cohere_get_embed_job
tools.description: Read one Cohere embed job: status (processing, complete, cancelling, cancelled, failed), model, truncate setting, input dataset and the output dataset with the embeddings. Free.
